title: Policy change lineage and enriched audit-event schema for admin actions
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a canonical audit event schema focused on policy (role/permission/binding) changes and enriched context for admin console and SSO-driven workflows. This ticket defines the taxonomy, a compact diff encoding for policy deltas (lineage-friendly), and enrichment fields (actor identity provenance, auth-assertion metadata, affected resource lineage) to support fast investigation, automated compliance checks, and downstream analytics.
background: Our existing audit corpus captures many admin events but lacks consistent lineage for role bindings and insufficient provenance when SAML/SCIM/SSO flows change identities. That fragmentation makes investigations slow and prevents accurate reconstruction of effective permissions over time. This work ties into RBAC v2 rollout and the unified audit envelope initiative. It must support compact diffs for storage efficiency while being queryable for legal/compliance timelines.
goals: Define a single event shape for policy-change events (create/update/delete/bulk) with an explicit 'lineage_id' and 'effective_at' timeline
Specify a delta encoding for role-binding and policy edits that is both human-diffable and storage-compact
Include identity provenance fields for SSO/SAML/SCIM-initiated changes to capture assertion IDs and upstream IdP metadata
Create migration/normalization guidance for historical audit records into the new envelope
scope: Admin console actions that modify roles, permissions, role-bindings, RBAC policies
Automated changes from SCIM and SAML provisioning flows, including group to role mappings
API-based admin actions (internal service-to-service, CLI) that mutate policy state
out_of_scope: General access logs (non-admin traffic), token-level request logs for user API calls
Fine-grained decision logs from the policy engine (those live in a separate PDP trace store)
Long-term retention policy enforcement (handled by retention infra ticket)
acceptance_criteria: Final JSON schema reviewed and approved by Security and Product (schema file committed to repo)
Migration script prototype that normalizes existing role-binding events into the new envelope and preserves 'effective_at' timestamps
Backend storage bench: new encoding reduces storage footprint for bulk role edits by >=40% vs naive full-copy events
Console timeline view renders complete lineage for a role-binding across edits and shows SSO provenance when present
decisions: Use a unified 'audit_envelope' top-level object with 'type', 'phase', 'lineage_id', 'effective_at' and 'payload' fields for forward/backward compatibility
Delta format: store explicit 'ops' list (add/remove/replace) with path-based targets using JSON Pointer syntax for consistent apply semantics
Provenance: include 'auth_source' object as enrichment (idp, assertion_id, assertion_claims_hash) but redact PII claims via deterministic hashing before storage
Compact storage: compress ops arrays using schema-aware compression (e.g., run-length or token mapping) in the archive tier; live index stores expanded ops for queries
diff_encoding_notes: We will use an ops-first JSON Pointer diff (RFC 6901 style paths) with a canonical ordering to make diffs deterministic. For large batch edits (bulk group-to-role mappings), we prefer an indexed-change format: 'op: bulk-replace', with a compressed payload and explicit 'preview_count' stored in the envelope. Archive compression will use a schema-aware codec; live indexes materialize expanded ops for search. Deltas must include both before/after summaries when available to aid change review.
retention_and_redaction: PII in assertion claims must be hashed before persistence; raw assertions only retained transiently in memory for validation
Store full ops in the hot store for 90 days, then move compressed archive with preservation of lineage_id for at least 2 years by default
Support per-customer retention overrides via dedicated tags preserved in the envelope (e.g., 'retention:enterprise-7y')
migration_plan: Write a mapper that reads legacy admin events and emits the new audit_envelope, filling lineage_id using deterministic hashing of (resource_id + first_timestamp)
Run a dry migration on a replayed day to validate storage size and query fidelity
Add normalization job in ETL to backfill 'auth_source' when SCIM/SAML logs can be correlated by request_id
rollout_plan: Schema beta: enable for 10% of admin events (canary) and validate console timeline rendering and retention metrics
Run parity checks between legacy view and new view for 7 days before increasing traffic
Full rollover: switch default writer to audit_envelope after 90% parity and sign-off from Security
open_questions: How should we represent nested permission sets that are inherited vs explicitly granted? (flat ops vs specialized 'inheritance' op)
What SLA do we guarantee for correlation of SSO assertion metadata in backfills?
Should event signing be applied to lineage_id to protect tampering for legal preservation?
tasks: (A) Draft canonical schema JSON and add JSON Schema file to infra-audit repo (Ravi)
(B) Implement ops encoder/decoder and unit tests (backend infra team)
(C) Prototype console timeline UI for role-binding lineage (Design + Console FE)
(D) Create migration mapper and run a dry run (Data Eng)
(E) Security review and legal sign-off on retention/redaction plan
